title: A la Hongroise
identity: À la hongroise is No.4 of Dubois’s Pièces caractéristiques en forme de suite, Op.77, for alto saxophone and piano. The score title is confirmed in the ARTS² library catalog; a Hungaroton recording lists a 2:26 track. Catalog’s approximate 2:30 agrees at a broad level.

Indiana State School Music Association’s 2021–22 through 2026–27 Group I woodwind solo list includes the Dubois Op.77 suite under Alto Saxophone. The document allows a maximum five-minute actual performance and requires cuts when needed; it lists works without assigning individual difficulty levels.
